title: Adaptive Krylov Methods for Low-Rank Exponential Integrators
summary: Differential equations arise in numerous applications, particularly within scientific and technical contexts. Systems of stiff, time-dependent ordinary differential equations constitute the focus of this work. Exponential integrators are designed to solve such equations by integrating the linear part exactly, while simultaneously approximating the nonlinear part through a linear combination of $\varphi$-functions.
